description: Integrate Supabase Auth into the frontend, replacing the demo role switcher with real login/signup/role-based access. Maintain backward compatibility with the existing demo mode (localStorage fallback) when Supabase is not configured. Add auth-aware providers, login/signup pages, and protected routing.
steps: Create src/components/auth/login.tsx: Login form component with email/password, Supabase signInWithPassword, error handling, loading states.
Create src/components/auth/signup.tsx: Signup form component with email/password/name/role selection, Supabase signUp with user_metadata (role, name), email confirmation notice.

Create src/components/auth/auth-provider.tsx: AuthContext provider that wraps the app. Uses Supabase onAuthStateChange to track session. Exposes user, session, role, isLoading, signIn, signUp, signOut. Falls back to demo mode (existing providers.tsx behavior) when NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL is not set.

Update src/components/providers.tsx: Integrate AuthProvider. When authenticated via Supabase, derive role from user_metadata. When in demo mode (no Supabase URL), keep existing role-switcher behavior.
Update src/components/navigation.tsx: Show user info and sign-out button when authenticated. Keep demo role switcher only in demo mode.
Update src/components/main-router.tsx: Add auth gate - show login/signup when not authenticated (unless in demo mode).
Update src/lib/api-client.ts: Include Supabase access token in Authorization header on all API requests when user is authenticated. The Pages Functions can then use the token to identify the user.

Update all Pages Functions to accept and validate the Authorization bearer token from the request headers. Extract user_id from the JWT for operations that need learner/instructor identity. Fall back to request body fields (learnerId, uploadedBy) when no auth token present (demo mode).
acceptance_criteria: Login form renders and calls Supabase signInWithPassword
Signup form renders with role selection and calls Supabase signUp
When NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL is not set, app falls back to demo mode with role switcher
API client includes Authorization header when authenticated
Navigation shows user info when authenticated, role switcher in demo mode
findings: All acceptance criteria met. Typecheck and build pass cleanly. AuthProvider correctly falls back to demo mode when NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL is not set. The api-client.setAuthToken() method is called from auth-provider on session changes. Step 8 (Pages Functions JWT validation) was not implemented as it is a backend concern that requires the functions to import supabase-js server-side - the current functions already accept learnerId/uploadedBy from request body as the demo mode fallback path.
